description.text:
# Solar Studio Stack — illustration reference

Design revision: 2.0.0 · schema containers-hamlet-design/v2.0 · design hash 0ac1e7b3

This description is generated from the canonical design model. The reference SVG is the authoritative geometric reference. The illustration prompt is an interpretation.

## Architectural facts
- 2 occupied storeys
- 2 container modules (20ft, 20ft)
- solar-ready roof at 12 degrees
- 29.5 m2 gross floor area
- 16.7 m2 ground coverage
- 7.69 m to the roof

## Modules
- **m1** — storey 1, 6.058 × 2.438 m, base 0.6 m, rotation 0°, timber cladding.
- **m2** — storey 2, 6.058 × 2.438 m, base 3.896 m, rotation 0°, metal cladding. m2 is offset 0.8 m east relative to m1.

## Openings
- m1 / Living doors — south sliding-door, 2 × 2.1 m, sill 0 m.
- m1 / Entry door — south door, 0.95 × 2.1 m, sill 0 m.
- m1 / Kitchen window — north window, 1.2 × 1.2 m, sill 1.1 m.
- m1 / Bathroom window — west window, 0.8 × 1 m, sill 1.4 m.
- m2 / Studio glazing — south window, 2.4 × 1.6 m, sill 0.6 m.
- m2 / Studio window — north window, 1.2 × 1.2 m, sill 0.9 m.
- m2 / Balcony door — east door, 0.9 × 2.1 m, sill 0 m.

## Rooms and zones
- m1 / Living — living, 0–2.8 m. Compact ground-floor living; verify a 1.5 m turning space.
- m1 / Kitchen — kitchen, 2.8–4.2 m. Compact kitchen; verify clear approach.
- m1 / Bathroom — bathroom, 4.2–5.2 m. Ground-floor bathroom; adaptable layout target.
- m1 / Stair — circulation, 5.2–6 m. Compact stair; not step-free to the upper studio.
- m2 / Studio — work, 0–3.4 m. Upper studio; stair only.
- m2 / Sleeping — sleeping, 3.4–6 m. Upper sleeping; stair only.

## Outdoor spaces
- p1: 4.4 × 2.4 m covered porch on the south face of m1.

## Site and camera
- Assigned site: Cabin F (site rotation 80°).
- Principal view: The southern cove of Heron Lake through juniper and cedar, with the opposite shore close enough to read the rock.
- Path approach: north-east
- Camera: exterior three-quarter view, 1.6 m, 35 mm, bearing 295°.

## Interior schedule
- Living (living) — 6.11 m², m1, inferred-from-zone.
- Kitchen (kitchen) — 2.9 m², m1, inferred-from-zone.
- Bathroom (bathroom) — 1.98 m², m1, inferred-from-zone.
- Stair (circulation) — 1.52 m², m1, inferred-from-zone.
- Studio (work) — 7.49 m², m2, inferred-from-zone.
- Sleeping (sleeping) — 5.65 m², m2, inferred-from-zone.
- Partitions: 0 · doors: 0 · fixtures: 0.
- Validation: 0 invalid, 8 unresolved, 6 review.

## Fire and water services
- Fire intent: roof class A; noncombustible deck: false; fire-water access confirmed: false; defensible space: 10 m (conceptual).
- Rainwater: conceptual; storage cistern; potable: false; fire reserve separate: true; fire connection verified: false.
- Fire protection, fire-water access and rainwater collection are conceptual intents/unknowns. No fire-resistance rating, WUI approval, tank sizing, potable-water testing or fire-service connection is designed.

## Intentions
- Step-free entrance is a design intent, not a verified measurement.
- Adaptable bathroom is a design intent, not a verified layout.
- Adaptable kitchen is a design intent, not a verified layout.

## Unresolved matters
- **interior-partitions**: Interior partitions, fixtures and camera geometry are conceptual or provisional. Do not claim a spatially accurate perspective or verified clearance.
- **unmodeled-balcony**: The upper east door is not accompanied by a modeled balcony, porch or deck on the same face. Do not draw an accessible balcony; guarding, support and egress are unresolved.
- **alternating-tread-stair**: The alternating-tread stair is recorded but its usability and code acceptability are unresolved. Do not present it as an acceptable permanent-residence solution.

- **water-system-conceptual**: Rainwater collection is a conceptual intent only. Tank size, location, yield, freeze protection, overflow, filtration and treatment are not designed.
- **fire-water-not-verified**: The fire reserve is separate in intent but no volume, connection or fire-service verification is recorded. Do not show a confirmed hydrant or cistern.
- **non-potable-water**: The rainwater system is not recorded as potable. Do not imply drinking-water safety; treatment and testing are unresolved.
- **fire-water-access-unconfirmed**: Fire-service water access is not confirmed. Do not draw a working hydrant, cistern or draft point as if verified.
- **combustible-deck**: The deck/porch is not recorded as noncombustible. Combustible decking, stored firewood and under-floor storage are fire risks; do not present them as resolved.
- **fire-separation-not-assessed**: Inter-storey and inter-module fire separation, protected egress and cavity barriers are not assessed. Do not imply a fire-resistance rating.
- **provisional-interior**: Interior geometry is provisional. Partitions, doors and fixtures may be incomplete.
- **inferred-room**: Room room-m1-m1-z1 is inferred from a zone band, not an authored layout.
- **inferred-room**: Room room-m1-m1-z2 is inferred from a zone band, not an authored layout.
- **inferred-room**: Room room-m1-m1-z3 is inferred from a zone band, not an authored layout.
- **inferred-room**: Room room-m1-m1-z4 is inferred from a zone band, not an authored layout.
- **inferred-room**: Room room-m2-m2-z1 is inferred from a zone band, not an authored layout.
- **inferred-room**: Room room-m2-m2-z2 is inferred from a zone band, not an authored layout.
- **doors-missing**: No interior doors are modeled. Room connectivity cannot be assessed.

- Exterior reference: available
- Interior perspective: not available — no interior camera or perspective renderer is implemented
- Room-zone plan: available
- Roof plan: available

Concept only. Not engineered, permit-ready or professionally reviewed. Code AGPL-3.0-or-later; original content CC BY-SA 4.0.
